text:
Renee (Finance): Received invoice from Continental Dataworks (CDW) - they sent EUR 15,200 for platform fees, VAT 0% and note 'reverse charge'. But their AP team also emailed asking for a gross-up if we pay from Redwood Inc because of alleged US withholding. Can we confirm next steps?

invoice-bot: New invoice #CDW-7781 1802004305 received 04/15/26 amount EUR 15,200 vendor VAT: NL556677889B03

Tom (Vendor Ops): I ran a quick check: invoice billed to "Redwood BV" on PDF, VAT line 'reverse charge'. Vendor's email thread references payment from Redwood Inc which may be the source of confusion. Need to confirm billed entity and paying entity.

Hector (Tax): Short answer: VAT vs withholding are separate. If invoice is to Redwood B.V. and payment flows from our EU bank, reverse charge should apply and no VAT withheld. If they want to be paid by Redwood Inc (US) and claim US-sourced income subject to withholding, then W-8BEN-E (or other appropriate US tax form) is required to substantiate residency and withholding rate. We do not gross-up by default.

June (Accounting): Quick invoice summary:
```
Invoice: CDW-7781
Date: 2026-04-14
Billed to: Redwood B.V. (VAT NL987654321B02)
Amount: EUR 15,200
VAT: 0% (reverse charge)
Payment terms: 30 days
```

Renee (Finance): Draft reply to vendor: "Please confirm the legal entity to which this invoice is addressed. If Redwood B.V. is correct and you are VAT-registered in NL, provide a VAT registration extract to support reverse charge. If payment will be made from a US entity and you expect no withholding, provide a completed W-8BEN-E and a written gross-up calculation plus the contractual clause that requires gross-up. Payment is on hold until we receive the required tax documents." Thoughts?

Tom (Vendor Ops): Also ask where the services were performed (NL vs US). That can change sourcing and withholding exposure.

Hector (Tax): Agreed. Add: "We will not accept an oral request for gross-up. Any request must be documented in contract or invoice annex. If you supply a gross-up calc, we'll need Legal sign-off before approval."

June (Accounting): I'll place payment on hold and flag AP ticket with the doc request.

invoice-bot: Payment hold placed: reason 'awaiting tax docs' 1802004360

Renee (Finance): Thanks — I'll send the note to vendor now. If they push for immediate gross-up, escalate to Legal and Tax. :thinking_face:

Hector (Tax): One more note: if vendor is not EU tax resident or claims US residency, W-9 vs W-8 distinction matters. We'll guide them on form choice once they state residency.

Renee (Finance): Good call. Closing the thread once docs received. :white_check_mark:
